references.text: Take delight in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Commit your way to the Lord; trust in him, and he will act.

He who walks righteously and speaks uprightly, who spurns gain from oppression, who waves his hands so as not to hold a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing about bloodshed, and shuts his eyes against looking on evil; such a one shall dwell on the heights; his refuge will be the fortress of rocks; his bread will be given him; his water will be secure.
But without faith it is impossible to please God. For whoever would draw near to God must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who seek him.
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. See how the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and the late rains.
